defs.d: Direction.
Preparation.
To prepare oneself.
To direct speech.
A description of the earth: a treatise or textbook on geography; an atlas or gazetteer.
The study of the physical properties of the earth, including how humans affect and are affected by them.
A place where agricultural and similar activities take place, especially the growing of crops or the raising of livestock.
A tract of land held on lease for the purpose of cultivation.
To work on a farm, especially in the growing and harvesting of crops.
To devote (land) to farming.
A (usually marked) place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off, usually smaller than a station.
defs.ex: They agreed to meet at the bus stop.

defs.d: An action of stopping; interruption of travel.
defs.ex: That stop was not planned.

defs.d: To cease moving.
defs.ex: I stopped at the traffic lights.

defs.d: To not continue.
defs.ex: Soon the rain will stop.

defs.d: A unit of mass equal to 16 avoirdupois ounces (= 453.592 37 g). Today this value is the most common meaning of "pound" as a unit of weight.
A unit of mass equal to 12 troy ounces (≈ 373.242 g). Today, this is a common unit of weight when measuring precious metals, and is little used elsewhere.

A way used for travelling between places, originally one wide enough to allow foot passengers and horses to travel, now (US) usually one surfaced with asphalt or concrete and designed to accommodate many vehicles travelling in both directions. In the UK both senses are heard: a country road is the same as a country lane.
A road; or particularly a car, as a means of transportation.
defs.ex: We travelled to the seaside by road.

defs.d: At the venue of the opposing team or competitor; on the road.
(Slang) Having attributes, primarily masculine, suggesting a tendency towards minor crime. Usually used by youths endearingly; glorifying crime.
To lay or place; to put (one thing to another)
defs.ex: to apply cream to a rash

defs.d: To put to use; to use or employ for a particular purpose, or in a particular case
defs.ex: to apply funds to the repayment of a debt

defs.d: True, real, actual.
defs.ex: He tried his very best.

defs.d: The same; identical.
defs.ex: He proposed marriage in the same restaurant, at the very table where they first met.

defs.d: To a great extent or degree.
defs.ex: Not very many (of them) had been damaged.

defs.d: Conforming to fact, reality or rule; true.
An arthropod in the class Insecta, characterized by six legs, up to four wings, and a chitinous exoskeleton.
defs.ex: Our shed has several insect infestions, including ants, yellowjackets, and wasps.

defs.d: Any small arthropod similar to an insect including spiders, centipedes, millipedes, etc
defs.ex: The swamp is swarming with every sort of insect.

defs.d: In or to all locations under discussion.
defs.ex: He delivers the mail everywhere on this street.

defs.d: In or to a few or more locations.
defs.ex: I've looked everywhere in the house and still can't find my glasses.

defs.d: A heavy yellow elemental metal of great value, with atomic number 79 and symbol Au.
A coin or coinage made of this material, or supposedly so.
To pyrolyze or burn food until the color begins to change to a light brown, but not as dark as browning
Made of gold.
Having the colour of gold.
Someone who listens, especially to a speech or a broadcast.
(chiefly Java) A function that runs in response to an event; an event handler.
Official residence of a head of state or other dignitary, especially in a monarchical or imperial governmental system.
A large and lavishly ornate residence.
To decorate or ornate.
(Manchester) An outer garment that covers the body from the waist downwards, covering each leg separately, usually as far as the ankles; trousers.
An undergarment that covers the genitals and often the buttocks and the neighbouring parts of the body; underpants.
Of inferior quality, rubbish.
defs.ex: Your mobile is pants — why don’t you get one like mine?

defs.d: A piece of knowledge that is hidden and intended to be kept hidden.
defs.ex: "Can you keep a secret?" "Yes." "So can I."

defs.d: The key or principle by which something is made clear; the knack.
defs.ex: The secret to a long-lasting marriage is compromise.

defs.d: To make or keep secret.
To hide secretly.
defs.ex: He was so scared for his safety he secreted arms around the house.

defs.d: Being or kept hidden.
defs.ex: We went down a secret passage.

defs.d: Withdrawn from general intercourse or notice; in retirement or secrecy; secluded.
In the recent past
defs.ex: a recently published book

defs.d: To match (something or someone which one currently perceives) to a memory of some previous encounter with the same person or thing.
defs.ex: I recognised his face immediately.

defs.d: To acknowledge the existence or legality of; to treat as valid or worthy of consideration.
defs.ex: The US and a number of EU countries are expected to recognize Kosovo on Monday.

defs.d: The part of an animal's body between the base of the neck and forearm socket.
Anything forming a shape resembling a human shoulder.
To push (a person or thing) using one's shoulder.
To put (something) on one's shoulders.
A bag stitched to an item of clothing, used for carrying small items.
Such a receptacle seen as housing someone's money; hence, financial resources.
defs.ex: I paid for it out of my own pocket.

defs.d: To put (something) into a pocket.
To cause a ball to go into one of the pockets of the table; to complete a shot.
Of a size suitable for putting into a pocket.
defs.ex: a pocket dictionary

defs.d: Smaller or more compact than usual.
A distinguishing attribute or quality.
A remedy for a specific disease or condition.
Explicit or definite
Pertaining to a species.
A demand of ownership made for something.
defs.ex: a claim of ownership

defs.d: The thing claimed.
To demand ownership of.
To state a new fact, typically without providing evidence to prove it is true.
That which one is morally or legally obligated to do.
defs.ex: We don't have a duty to keep you here.

defs.d: The state of being at work and responsible for or doing a particular task.
defs.ex: I’m on duty from 6 pm to 6 am.

defs.d: A relatively low-gravity beer, often with a dark colour; mild ale
Gentle and not easily angered.
defs.ex: a mild man

defs.d: (of a rule or punishment) Of only moderate severity; not strict.
defs.ex: He received a mild sentence.

defs.d: To raise (someone) to a more important, responsible, or remunerative job or rank.
defs.ex: He promoted his clerk to office manager.

defs.d: To advocate or urge on behalf of (something or someone); to attempt to popularize or sell by means of advertising or publicity.
defs.ex: They promoted the abolition of daylight saving time.

defs.d: Rock that is ground more finely than gravel, but is not as fine as silt (more formally, see grain sizes chart), forming beaches and deserts and also used in construction.
(often in the plural) A beach or other expanse of sand.
defs.ex: The Canadian tar sands are a promising source of oil.

defs.d: Of a light beige colour, like that of typical sand.
To ward off attacks against; to fight to protect; to guard.
To support by words or writing; to vindicate, talk in favour of.
The act of measuring.
Magnitude (or extent or amount) determined by an act of measuring.
An administrative division of an area.
defs.ex: the Soho district of London

defs.d: An area or region marked by some distinguishing feature.
defs.ex: the Lake District in Cumbria

defs.d: To divide into administrative or other districts.
Rigorous; stringent; harsh
To stress, give emphasis or extra weight to (something).
defs.ex: His two-fingered gesture emphasized what he had told his boss to do with his job.

defs.d: A dark image projected onto a surface where light (or other radiation) is blocked by the shade of an object.
defs.ex: My shadow lengthened as the sun began to set.

defs.d: Relative darkness, especially as caused by the interruption of light; gloom, obscurity.
defs.ex: I immediately jumped into shadow as I saw them approach.

defs.d: To shade, cloud or darken.
defs.ex: The artist chose to shadow this corner of the painting.

defs.d: To block light or radio transmission from.
defs.ex: Looks like that cloud's going to shadow us.

defs.d: Unofficial, informal, unauthorized, but acting as though it were.
defs.ex: The human resources department has a shadow information technology group without headquarters knowledge.

defs.d: Having power or influence, but not widely known or recognized.
defs.ex: The director has been giving shadow leadership to the other group's project to ensure its success.

defs.d: Towards a higher place; towards what is above.
To a higher figure or amount.

A process by which heritable traits conferring survival and reproductive advantage to individuals, or related individuals, tend to be passed on to succeeding generations and become more frequent in a population, whereas other less favourable traits tend to become eliminated; the differential survival and reproduction of phenotypes.
The process or act of selecting.
defs.ex: The large number of good candidates made selection difficult.

defs.d: Something selected.
defs.ex: My final selection was a 1934 Chateau Lafitte.
